input.summary: Test the vari-targets. Repeat full-depth hits when the flippers are strong and the returns are safe. Otherwise, keep sending the ball up top.

quickInfo.name: Three-one-two skill shot
quickInfo.summary: Each top lane scores the same, so choose the lane that feeds a bumper most often.

quickInfo.name: Vari-target value
quickInfo.summary: A vari-target scores up to 500 when a strong, accurate shot pushes it fully backward.

quickInfo.name: Base runners
quickInfo.summary: The numbered top lanes, numbered standups, vari-target hits, and side lanes move runners around the bases.

quickInfo.name: Lit bumpers
quickInfo.summary: Both bumpers light together when runners occupy second and third base.

quickInfo.name: Side drains
quickInfo.summary: Each side drain scores 500, which can materially change a close game.

steps.text: Plunge the top 3, 1, or 2 lane that gives the best bumper feed.
Test one vari-target with a controlled full-force shot.
Track the target depth and the complete ball return.
Repeat the vari-target when full-depth hits score 500 and return safely.
Use natural lane and target results to place runners on second and third.
When both bumpers light, stop direct vari-target play.
Send the ball to the upper playfield while both bumpers remain lit.
Return to the tested vari-target after the bumper lights turn off.

fallback.title: Upper-playfield route
fallback.when: Use this plan when weak flippers or unsafe returns prevent consistent full-depth vari-target hits.

steps.text: Stop direct vari-target shots.
Send the ball through the broadest route to the upper playfield.
Use top lanes to place runners and seek natural bumper action.
Repeat upper play while the center return remains survivable.

alternatives.title: Single-then-double bumper setup
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the vari-targets return safely and the bumpers are unlit.

steps.text: Use a shallow vari-target hit to score a single.
Use the next vari-target hit to score a double.
Confirm that runners now occupy second and third.
Send the ball up top while both bumpers are lit.
Place one runner on base with a single.
Score a double to move runners to second and third.
Confirm that both bumpers light.
Repeat upper-playfield shots while the bumpers remain lit.

techniques.name: Feed-based skill shot
techniques.instruction: Test each top 3-1-2 lane. Reuse the lane that sends the ball into the bumpers most reliably.

techniques.name: Vari-target depth test
techniques.instruction: Shoot one vari-target with a strong, centered stroke. Continue only when it reaches full depth and returns safely.

techniques.name: Side-lane speed read
techniques.instruction: Watch the ball speed from each double and triple lane. Nudge before a known speed reaches a slingshot or drain path.

cautions.issue: A triple always removes the lit-bumper state.
cautions.response: Stop deep vari-target shots while the bumpers are lit. Use upper-playfield shots until the lights turn off.

cautions.issue: Side double and triple lanes can feed a flipper, slingshot, side drain, or center drain.
cautions.response: Learn each lane's feed at different speeds. Nudge before the ball reaches the slingshot or return-lane wire.

cautions.issue: A center feed can glance from a vari-target chute into a slingshot instead of a flipper.
cautions.response: Track the chute contact. Nudge before the deflection reaches the slingshot edge.

checkBeforePlay: Identify Baseball model 290 or add-a-ball Batter Up model 301; they share a playfield but use different awards.
Confirm ball count, replay or Extra Ball treatment, tilt consequence, and runner and bumper lamp registration.
Test both vari-targets for full 500-point travel, side lanes at several speeds, and the upper-playfield center feed.
